name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $4,134 on 9 Nov, down 7.5% over three months and back inside the Normal band
state: Gold futures were near $4,134 early on 9 Nov, 7.5% lower over three months, back inside the 8% fall that marks Watch, after a rise of 4.9% on the week (Yahoo Finance). The weekly move is below the 7% Alert line. The price is about 22% under its 52-week high.
for_you: Gold is often read as a gauge of investor anxiety. Its recent moves have been large, but the three-month change has returned to its usual range.
rubric_hit: Gold 3-month change −7.5%, inside the −8% to +10% Normal band; weekly move +4.9% < 7%
why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.
